Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

I had been really excited to start my new job, especially since this company has such a diverse, international workforce. At the office next to me, there's an Irish man, and on the other side an Icelandic man. The whole office went out for drinks together just last week. While we were there, my Irish coworker had so many different anecdotes and really had the whole office doubled over in laughter. The night was a bit ruined by my Icelandic coworker, though. It started out fine, but after their fourth beer, things went really downhill and it was just embarrassing. Who got really drunk?
A. The Irish man
B. Not answerable
C. The Icelandic man
